device.description: quad 8-bit voltage-output DAC with individual references, 8-bit parallel input port, double-buffered with common LDAC
device.note: tlc7225.pdf (SLAS109B) p.1 (pinout, description), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 11.4-16.5 V, VSS -5.5-0 V, TTL levels; timing requirements, Figure 1), p.9 (interface logic, Table 1 addressing), p.10 (Table 2 truth table, Figure 5)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A input register (Table 1: A1 A0 = 00); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.9); power-on code not stated

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B input register (Table 1: A1 A0 = 01); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.9); power-on code not stated

registers.name: INC
registers.note: DAC C input register (Table 1: A1 A0 = 10); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.9); power-on code not stated

registers.name: IND
registers.note: DAC D input register (Table 1: A1 A0 = 11); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.9); power-on code not stated

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A DAC register; all four transparent while LDAC is low, latched on LDAC rising (p.9, Table 2)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B DAC register; all four transparent while LDAC is low, latched on LDAC rising (p.9, Table 2)

registers.name: DACC
registers.note: DAC C DAC register; all four transparent while LDAC is low, latched on LDAC rising (p.9, Table 2)

registers.name: DACD
registers.note: DAC D DAC register; all four transparent while LDAC is low, latched on LDAC rising (p.9, Table 2)

commands.name: Write input register (WR low)
commands.note: A1 A0 select the input register (Table 1); transparent while WR is low, latched on WR rising (p.9, Table 2)

ldac.note: DAC registers transparent while LDAC is low, all four latched on LDAC rising (p.3, p.9, Table 2)

pages: p.1 (pinout, description), p.3 (terminal functions), p.4 (recommended operating conditions: VDD 11.4-16.5 V, VSS -5.5-0 V, TTL levels; timing requirements, Figure 1), p.9 (interface logic, Table 1 addressing), p.10 (Table 2 truth table, Figure 5)
notModeled: analog: voltage outputs, reference inputs REFA-REFD, single or dual (VSS = -5 V) supply operation, settling
power-on state of the input and DAC registers is not stated in the datasheet (0 used)
the input register is level-transparent while WR is low; the model latches the data at WR rising (end of the write)
no chip select: every WR low pulse writes the addressed input register
pin table (p.3) lists 'A0, A1 / 18, 19'; the pinout drawing (p.1), block diagram (p.2) and Figure 5 (p.10) give A0 = 19, A1 = 18, which is used
variants: tlc7225.pdf covers TLC7225C (0-70 C) and TLC7225I (-25-85 C), same pinout and interface.
